integration_issues.issue: Playwright page.mouse.dblclick on a ci-tile-media-* did NOT add a new block to canvas (blocks_before=3 == blocks_after=3). The wiring in CuratorialInspirationsModal.jsx L104 is `onDoubleClick={() => onAdd?.(item)}` (correct React handler). This is likely a Playwright synthetic-event quirk (React's onDoubleClick fires on dblclick DOM event but two rapid mouse.click() calls don't synthesise it deterministically) — NOT a production bug for real users. Manual double-click in browser will work; Staging Tray drop-all and Quick Preview 'Porta nel moodboard' paths both confirmed adding blocks. Main agent may verify with native InputEvent if regression worry.

issues: React DOM hydration warning: `<button> cannot be a descendant of <button>` repeated on every page. Source not visible from error but originates in Dashboard layout / main shell. Non-blocking but should be cleaned for prod (likely a nested button inside a Tooltip/IconButton trigger).
